request_state.step: Z[i] is a UFD and every unit is a cube, so a+bi=(u+vi)^3 for some u,v in Z with gcd(u,v)=1 and u+v odd; hence a=|u(u^2-3v^2)|, b=|v(3u^2-v^2)| up to swapping the roles of a and b.
